- table: orders(id bigint pk, customer_id bigint fk -> customers.id, created_at timestamptz)
- add nullable column orders.external_id text
- backfill it by joining customers(id, account_number text) and setting external_id = 'acct_' || lower(account_number)
- add an index on orders.external_id
- then make external_id NOT NULL

add transaction guards and make every step idempotent (don’t blow up if re‑run). give me one runnable script, not separate snippets or a checklist.

target: Produce one complete, idempotent, copy‑and‑run SQL migration that performs all steps (add column, backfill via join, create index, set NOT NULL) with transaction/advisory guards; avoid disjointed queries or high‑level plans — deliver the finished artifact.
